item.title: Amish Fall Farmhouse Experience at Old Windmill Farm — Fri Sep 18 — Old Windmill Farm
item.description:
An autumn afternoon in our farm kitchen. Join us as we bake bread, churn butter from our own cows’ cream, and press apple cider with a traditional hand-cranked apple press. Then sit down and enjoy all three together, with the freshly churned butter on the bread warm from the oven.
Press fresh cider with a traditional press Churn butter from our own cows’ cream Enjoy freshly baked bread Drink cider and eat bread with fresh butter A working farm kitchen, not a demonstration Advance reservations required
Part of the visit is outdoors – dress for the weather. Book This Tour
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.title: Scootin’ for Scoops with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Fri Sep 18 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Enjoy a 5-star Lancaster County ice cream tour experience with Strasburg Scooter Tours. You’ll see rolling farmlands, pass by horse and buggies, and enjoy some of the best Ice Cream in Lancaster County! It’s a stark contrast to the usual fast-paced and congested areas of larger cities. For those craving something different or one of the best romantic date night ideas, join us! We designed this tour to be an experience you can share with someone. We’ll only use Scoot Coupes, so single riders will have to look for someone to bring on the tour. It will be well worth it as you can expect exceptional views. item.title: Evansburg Park — Sun Sep 20, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Walking Tails This walk goes out to the northeast about 1.25 miles and then we come back the way we came, for a total of 2.5 miles. The trail is a paved surface and fairly shady.
We will be meeting at the parking lot between the ranger's station and the playground, near the swings. CLICK DIRECTLY ON THE MAP IF YOU THINK YOU ARE LOST. IT WILL BRING YOU RIGHT TO US WHERE WE MEET.
Start Time: We will start hiking promptly at the scheduled time.
Duration of the walk – depends on the people and dogs in the group. We frequently end up walking in smaller packs based on the comfort level of the participants.
In the past this walk takes about 1 hour, and longer for time spent in the open fields.
Please remember pooh bags and that your dog must be on a leash that is no more than 10 feet long.

item.title: Mocktails & Meaning™: Lightworkers Documentary — Fri Oct 16, 5:00 PM — Church of the Apostles UCC
item.description:
As the 2026 midterm elections approach, Lightworkers invites us to consider the role each of us can play in strengthening our communities and democracy. On Friday, October 16th, this special Mocktails & Meaning™ gathering will feature a free screening of Lightworkers, a documentary directed by Bobby Roth that shares personal stories from people responding to social, political, and environmental challenges. The film explores individual choices, collective responsibility, and the many ways people can contribute to a more just and compassionate world. A light dinner will be served from 5–6 PM, followed by the documentary at 6 PM and a Q&A with director Bobby Roth afterward. Come watch, reflect, and consider the film’s central question: What can we do?
Source: Church of the Apostles UCC
